title: Silky Comfort Without the Fur Drama
body:
I've been really impressed with the Ecoy Fur-Friendly Bamboo Quilt Cover Set. The bamboo fabric has a beautifully cool, soft, silk-like feel that makes it incredibly comfortable to sleep in, especially during warmer nights.

As a pet owner, one of the standout features is how well it handles cat fur. Unlike traditional cotton bedding where fur tends to weave into the fabric and stick, fur brushes off this quilt cover very easily, making it much simpler to keep clean and looking fresh.

My cats also seem to love the softness of the material and are often found curled up on the bed. The only downside I've found is that the fabric can be prone to pulls if cat claws catch on it, so a little extra care is needed around sharp nails.

Overall, it's a fantastic option for pet owners looking for a soft, cooling, and fur-friendly bedding solution that is both comfortable and practical.

title: Hell yeah brother
body:
we got a new mattress that we didn't realise was exceptionally deep, so we had to invest in some new sheets. it took a while for us to decide, but we landed on the ecoy bamboo cooling sheets. Never had bamboo sheets before but we liked the colours/patterns, we sleep hot and we have 2 sheddy cats. They came quickly, nicely packaged in seperate little bags. Washed as recommended. Let me god damn tell you the feel of these things is something else. The only thing I can sort of liken it to is the difference between washing your hair at home, and getting it blown out at the hair dresser. So soft, sleek, almost flowing. I'm unfortunately obsessed.
In the morning I did notice a small hole in the top sheet which was upsetting as they weren't cheap. I was worried I'd have to pack them up and mail them back and then the waiting game would begin. Fortunately, after sending a photo to the team, they immediately sent out a replacement. I just picked up the express posted parcel to find they sent an entire new set, not just the one that had a fault. That is honestly crazy to me, but I'm happy for it. 
When we are able we will definitely be picking up some more in different colours, very keen to mix and match.

Bought the corduroy quilt cover in eggplant for our super king. 

Stuff we love: zipper closure, snap (instead of tie) corners and a bonus centre snap at the top of the quilt to prevent it from slouching at the top! The weight of the quilt is perfect - feel snug and comfy without overheating.

Stuff we love less: Our bed is huge and I didn't anticipate how prominent the eggplant colour would be. It's a lot. A LOT of eggplant colour in our room.

title: Unexpended and Incredible Bedding
body:
Got gifted a Ecoy set for my birthday after consistent complaint about my cats fur being everywhere on my bed. 
First up it was flanno, I was already excited because I like to sleep in a warm bed with cold aircon. It was really impressive. 
After a few days the cats hair started accumulating - I thought here we go another sham product. 
The cat hair actually wipes off the bedspread! 
I was blown away, so I went and got a second set in the bamboo for summer. 
The bamboo one is incredible too. Always cold to the touch. Always super cozy when you are in bed. 
It's made very well too. Pillowcases don't fall off, the sheets are easy to put on, the comforter has a zipper instead of buttons or clips. 
I really recommend this bedding for pets, comfort, quality and coziness.

title: Good enough that I bought a second set
body:
This is my second Ecoy Cooling Bamboo Sheet Set, which probably says more than anything else I could put in a review.

After trying the first set, I was impressed enough to order another so I could rotate between them. They're extremely comfortable, feel soft and breathable, and don't have that heavy or overly warm feeling some sheets can develop during the night.

As a hot sleeper, keeping cool is one of the main things I look for in bedding, and these have been excellent. I've been sleeping noticeably better since changing over to Ecoy and have been very happy with the quality and feel.

It's not often I buy the same bedding twice in quick succession, but these were an easy repeat purchase. Definitely recommended.

On arrival it it totally different model to the one my husband has. The inserts are a different material and HARD the memory foam itself is totally different to my husbands pillow and it's also HARD. 
I've slept on it for 6 months hoping that it would be a 'wear in' type of situation and soften, even swapping pillows with my husband so I could get a good nights sleep. 
However, unfortunately it's still hard and nothing at all like my friends or my husbands pillow…
I'm extremely disappointed. 
If some how they continued to make them the same as they used to (my best friend purchased theirs a year ago) I'd definitely spend the money again.

title: Lovely sheets
body:
Lovely feel, nice to sleep in and beautiful colours available.
There's a few things I look for in sheets and sheet sets.
The pillow case. Must be big enough to fit ergonomic pillows and have a deep enough fold for the internal tuck to secure the pillow in. These pillow cases nailed that!
The fitted sheet for me needs to have a strong secure enough elastic cuff that the stitching won't come undone and also needs to be deep enough to fit a deeper mattress.
These are an ok fit, only just comes down and a little bit that tucks under while the elastic cuff looks nice feels like the stitching will come undone at some point. 
The flat sheet, not wide enough to tuck in at the sides on those deeper mattresses.
Overall would be a nice comfortable fit on standard size mattresses. They are good to sleep in.

body: Wow. I first tried these sheets as I was looking for a cruelty free doin alternative to wool and down feathers.  I was blown away when I ordered these sheets/doona/pillows and opened them up. I always run hot so find myself waking in the night in sweaty pjs. These silky, soft, cooling sheets feel like luxury (better than even the most expensive hotel sheets I've stayed in). However this is not the only thing I was blown away by. The doona has little loops that attach to the quilt cover (which has a little pop button to secure this). The silky sheets ALWAYS stay in place with this doona. THEN there is the reinforced fitted sheet elastic, this is deeper than regular sheets and hugs my mattress and never slips off. My two dogs and two cats fur glides right off when I shake the doona and sheets, so no nasty fur in the washing machine AND the fitted sheet sides are labelled, what else can they think of. I am in love with these sheets, will be a returning customer and the colours are gorgeous. Oh and the pillows I have (warm/cool side) are the comfiest I've ever owned and I received the face mask as a freebie and I cannot imagine sleeping without it. It's comfortable, cooling and actually blocks out the light. I suffer from headaches and migraines so this is a must for me not just for bed time. Thank you so much for creating a product that actually delivers what it says it will do. I'm thrilled.

title: All bamboo sheets are not created equal
body:
These sheets are everything they promised: silky, soft, gorgeous colours and nice deep sides on the fitted sheets, but that's not why I bought them. 

I care about the planet. I know that cotton is an intensive crop that uses megalitres of water and chemicals while degrading land, and synthetic fabrics are plastics, destined to pollute our soils forever. Bamboo seems like an obvious choice but turning it into fabric might mean some serious environmental damage. 

Bamboo might also be drenched in chemicals, and the viscose process, which involves dissolving and extruding bamboo fibres, can be energy intensive and produce toxic waste. 

That's why I did plenty of research before choosing Ecoy bamboo sheets for my bed. 

First up, they are actually 100% bamboo, and not a cotton/bamboo blend or a sneaky bamboo/polyester blend like one other online offering. 

Then there's the organic certification on the bamboo, so I know it hasn't been drenched in chemicals. 

Finally there's the Oeko Tex 100 standard, which means these sheets have been tested for over 1,000 harmful substances and are safe for human health. 

Ecoy are also the only company I have found that include factual information about bamboo fabrics and manufacturing processes on their website. They are open about sustainability claims needing a good pinch of reality. 

Their site bills bamboo sheets as "cooling", and they certainly are beautifully comfortable in hot weather, but don't assume they aren't also dreamy in winter. I now have three sets of Ecoy sheets and they are all I use, winter or summer. Unlike cotton sheets, there is no chill when you climb in on a cold night and the silkiness is snuggly during the colder months. No need for flannelette or electric blankets.  

That should be enough for a review, but it's worth adding that Ecoy also give back, ensuring that a small percentage of their profits go to worthwhile charities, including environmental projects and mentoring girls. 

The negatives? I honestly can't find any.

title: Super soft and warm with a good weight to it!
body:
I got this sheet set as a gift from the incredibly nice guys at Ecoy so I thought it only fair to give it an honest review!!! To clarify though they haven't asked me for this review and this is genuinely 100% just my thoughts!
Aussie winters are sooo cold - our houses are notorious for being atrocious when it comes to keeping in the heat, so I usually have a few blankets on top of my quilt (and an electric blanket on some nights!) 
I have abandoned my blankets and left my electric blanket off because the flannelette is so freaking soft and warm, I instantly felt like my bed was preheated and waiting for me. I cannot stress how much of a difference it made!! 
Some things in particular that delighted me was:
In clear ecoy fashion the sides are labelled and the elastic is THICK. It made the process of putting the sheets on a lot easier because I wasn't floundering trying to figure out which way is for the top/bottom and which way is for the sides.  I also really liked that the flat sheet had some good heft to it - I don't usually use a flat sheet because I'm quite an active sleeper and tend to fling it across the room in my sleep. Haven't slept with these sheets yet but fingers crossed it stays in place (I have high hopes!)
Anyway I really do love these sheets and I'm super glad I can support a small Aussie business, but really I'm just getting a kick out of upgrading my bedspread. Again THANK YOU to the guys at ecoy because it's clear you actually care about the quality of your products. Will hopefully be buying a flannelette quilt cover soon!

title: Cradled by a wealthy cloud
body:
I slid into these bamboo sheets from Ecoy and suddenly understood why people abandon responsibilities to become "one with the bed."

These sheets don't feel woven — they feel whispered into existence by sleepy forest fairies.

I used to wake up during the night. Now I wake up confused about what year it is after being wrapped in a buttery bamboo cloud.

The only problem is… they ruined every other bed for me.

So naturally I bought a set for my partner because I wanted to enjoy them at his house too. Then I bought some for my mum because everyone deserves this level of comfort and honestly I needed other people to understand what I've been going through emotionally.

Now I rotate between beds like a bamboo-sheet connoisseur: "Ah yes… subtle cooling notes… exceptional softness… outstanding nap potential."
At this point I'm not attached to material things. Except these sheets. These sheets I would defend in court.

title: I don't like the snaps, it could be more clear about having them
body:
It says the snaps are *only with all seasons 3-in-1 quilt, shows a picture of it on a bed without visible snaps, compares all quilt options where the snaps are only listed under the 3-in-1 version, but the summer bamboo quilt does actually have them.

These snaps are a design compromise for the convenience of a modular blanket, but I'm buying the single quilt because I sleep hot and don't want a second blanket to combine it with.

The last thing I want to do after I've bought a full set of your beautiful bedding is to snuggle into it and feel a hard disk of plastic, it's a small thing, but took away from the otherwise luxury experience for me.

So judging this as a standalone product, having snaps just makes the quilt more uncomfortable with no benefit. 
If you're not as bothered by things like that or intend to buy more than one, i think you'll be happy because it is good quality and i rarely found myself feeling too hot.

body: I grew up with four distinct seasons, where every Easter school holidays we had a "Ritual Changing of the Bedding" from summer to winter. I now live in an area with only Summer/Not Summer, but these new flannelette bedding sets enable me to experience the childish joy all over again. They are just so snuggly! Last week it was still 22 degrees at midnight, this week it has dropped to 8. Perfect timing. I can burrito myself with a stupid grin on my face as the temperature drops. The colour is heavenly, like that of a backlit cloud against a darker storm. They have all the tactile goodies, they look good, feel good. A great addition to the range.

title: Disappointingly wrinkly for the price
body:
For this price, I'm honestly quite disappointed with how extremely wrinkly this bedding gets. It completely ruins the overall aesthetic. The first thing people notice when they see my bed is asking why the sheets look so creased all the time. No matter how nicely you make the bed, the fabric wrinkles very easily and never really looks neat or luxurious because of that.

Another thing to be aware of - if you use skincare or a regular night moisturiser before bed (like most woman do), this fabric shows oily marks very easily on the pillowcases and sheets, even from small amounts of product.

It's a shame because the colour is beautiful.

Photo below shows how it looks like after simply waking up in the morning and making the bed. Really bad.

body:
I've purchased my fair share of quality bedding over the years but ecoy is the top of my list and my absolute favourite. 

Hair resistant - perfect for me who is a dog mum of two, and a dog groomer - I can't escape dog fur, yet I'm no longer waking up with mouthfuls in the morning like I used to. My husband is very impressed as he reports the same - and no fur in the yes either 😂

We're both hot sleepers - I purchased the all seasons quilt and a full sheet set with extra pillow cases and I've found sleeping has definitely been more comfortable. I now want to get rid of all my other sheets and only own ecoy, but I have to save for a while before I can get myself another full set 🫢

title: Perfect for winter!
body:
I love corduroy, so lookswise this quilt cover was an instant winner! It's perfect for winter too, because I've found it's a bit warmer than my other Ecoy quilt covers. It's great for that awkward seasonal transition when it's not quite cold enough to pull out your winter doona but too cold for your summer sheets to keep you cozy. 

The bamboo inner lining is so soft and silky, exactly what I'd expect from this brand! The pillowcases have a corduroy side and a bamboo side too so you can comfortably sleep on a silky pillow while still having a cohesive look during the day. 

It is a little heavier, but that works well for me—it's kind of like a weighted blanket vibe, and it means that I'm less likely to accidentally kick the doona off and freeze halfway through the night. But it can be a struggle to hang it on the washing line (though that's probably more of an indictment of my noodle arms). 

I've been using this quilt cover for about a week and a half now and my only issue has been the shedding. While I do expect corduroy to shed a little bit, having everything in my room covered in a noticeable layer of eggplant covered dust isn't quite ideal. Before using it for the first time, I washed the quilt cover inside out (as I usually do with my quilt covers), but when I washed it again I did so right-side out and made sure to give it a good shake. While there is definitely less shedding than the first week, it's still noticeable on my other furniture. Hopefully it'll improve over time and with more washings. 

I will also note that I have a queen-sized quilt cover and as you can see in the photos, there is a seam down the middle of the cover. I don't mind it as it's only on the corduroy side so I don't feel it at night, but I know some people might be bothered by it. 

I'm rating this five stars because, all-in-all, this is a pretty great quilt cover, and I expect corduroy to shed at least a little bit. It's not too much of an issue for me as I could use the reminder to wipe down my windowsills more often, but if you're particularly sensitive to dust, it's something to keep in mind. Apart from that, this is the perfect cozy quilt cover for winter!

title: Love this pillow!
body:
So I've previously been very happy with another brand's similar-shaped pillow, but decided to try Ecoy's because I love their sheets so much. 
At first I wasn't sure about this one because when I put both the extra inserts in (the same amount of inserts I used with the other brand) the pillow was so high it barely fit in the pillowcase. 
Then I tested it and it wasn't right.
I took out both the inserts and tried just the main pillow on its own. 
Absolutely PERFECT! 
I love the texture of the top of the pillow too. 
My only complaint is that the pillow had a strong chemical smell at first (it had been very tightly packed in plastic) but I aired it outside for a day or so before use and then it was fine. 

Suggestion: it would be great to be able to purchase extra pillow protectors for this pillow. The other brand doesn't sell them either and I know it frustrates many of us! Yes we can use standard pillow protectors while washing the official ones, but they don't fit as well - especially for those using the extra insert pieces.

title: No ragrets
body:
I was both skeptical and hesitant to purchase as I was previously buying all my sheets from another very expensive company simply because they had tabs on each corner stating top right top left etc and I hated wasting time trying one way only to realise I got it wrong. I thought they were the only company offering this solution and had I known ecoy had an alternate that achieves the same goal, I would have changed over earlier.  Both brand equally expensive as each other so I buy strategically when sales are on.  But ecoy claimed to repel pet hair. I thought - there is no way this is possible, if hair is going to fall, a bed sheet can't stop that ?! Anywho, there was a sale so I thought why not risk it for the biscuit and see if it does make a difference. 

I was shocked to see that after a week (when I change sheets) there was SIGNIFICANTLY less hair than usual. There was of course SOME hair, but mammoth amounts less than usual. My
Bed is tucked into an awkward pocket and you can't access either side, only the front - so I imagine there may also be a possibility you could brush off any hair that remains with ease? But I can't judge that. 

Overall I am satisfied that it genuine reduces pet hair to a significant standard, and next time I think I'll stick with this brand. 

Ironically I am not allergic to my dogs (but I am dust and cats) and my allergies have been worse since I changed these sheets. I do think it is unrelated and just coincidental timing, so I'll keep an eye on that. But I'm satisfied for now :)

title: Cost Effective Opulent Investment
body:
This is my second purchase of these sheets, they are a serious worthwhile investment.

As with any investment, true benefits are garnered over time.  These sheets keep on giving, so much so, I removed all other sheets sometime ago as these became the go to.  

To put your mind at rest, let's deal with the CONS first.  There is only one Con, it is the scary initial outlay. .  

Firstly, you won't return the sheets, so you will not be out of pocket.  You soon realise the real issue is, "You will not want to sleep on anything else", I do not say that in jest.

These sheets last for years, I still have my original set, minus the fitted sheet.  Now remember, the fitted sheet cops the flogging.  It is always on the bottom, some people have toenails designed for dinosaurs and eventually something has to give, only after years of abuse did that sheet falter.  The remainder of the set is still in excellent condition.  For what it is worth, the elastic was still doing fine right up to the point of incision.

For me, I decided the best return on my money was to do the following.

Purchase the sheet set.
Purchase an extra fitted sheet
Purchase an extra set of pillowcases.
Sorry ECOY, purchase when Ecoy have their sale, the savings are great

The extra fitted sheet halves the lion share of work for the bottom sheet and keeps your sheet set going for twice the time.

The extra pillowcases is a quick freshen up, plus we have four pillows on our bed.

When you eventually buy a second sheet set, you can mix and match your sheets, you may decide not to purchase the extra items outside of the sheet set.  Be warned, YOU will buy another sheet set and you will only purchase bamboo sheets from here on in.

I love both jewel tone and rich earthy colours, hence I am very happy with the colour selection.

The fitted sheet FITS and stays fitted.  No skimping on fabric in the flat sheet either.

Get family to collectively get together and pool for your birthday or Christmas present…….  Be first cab off the rank, the secret will be out of the bag when friends and family sleep over.

.

title: Worth Every Cent — Amazing Quality & Even Better Service
body:
What a fantastic company with an incredible product. Genuine customer service is hard to come by these days, with so many businesses focused purely on profit — but not this one. Ecoy's team truly listened to me and even fixed my ordering mistake without charging extra. Their responses were quick, and they treated me with such kindness and respect throughout the entire process. The sheets arrived super fast, and I was in love instantly. The material is absolutely beautiful, and for someone with sensory needs, they have been an absolute game changer. Even my husband keeps commenting on how amazing they feel — and he runs hot at night, so the bamboo cooling has genuinely improved both of our sleep and overall comfort.
Yes, they are a bit of an investment, but as someone who saved for weeks to purchase them, I can honestly say they are worth every cent. This is probably the first time I've ever strongly recommended a product, and that's because Ecoy truly delivers — both in quality and customer service. We don't have a fancy home or a big budget, but this bedding makes me feel like a million dollars. OH and I love that my cats can sleep in there too without leaving all their fur behind! The kindness I was shown just made the whole experience even more special.
I'll absolutely be recommending Ecoy to anyone looking for new bedding.

title: Perfect expect for one niggle..!
body: Hey I've tried every kind of bedding material from linen to cotton to satin…and now bamboo which is my favourite. These guys have made the loveliest silkiest bamboo bedding that I've come across in the most luscious colours. Fabulous. I was most excited to see the tags marking the sides of the fitted sheet because I ALWAYS put it on the mattress the wrong way and have to waste time pulling it off and on again. The only issue I have is with the quilt cover: that there are very short internal corner loops with studs to attached the doona internally to the quilt cover corners. WHAT THE? What if you don't have a doona with loops in the corners hmmm?!!! So now I'm going to have to sew some on because otherwise the doona slides right out of the quilt cover during the night, and bunches up by the foot by the  morning because the bamboo is so silky smooth, and it is a total pain in the proverbial even mid-sleep!! And why oh why is there not a zip instead of studs holding the opening closed?!! I really don't need my foot going through the gaps in the opening, and then having to redo them in the morning. Huff! Bedtime should not be this hard. Fix the internal loops (with two ribbons to tie to the corner of ANY doona you might have, like you find in some other brands) and put a zipper instead of press studs to hold the cover closed and THEN this bedding will be TOTAL PERFECTION.

body: I purchased two sets of Queen sized 'Storm Blue' limited edition sheets for an 80-year-old friend, and she absolutely adores them! She is a hot sleeper and loves the way they draw heat away from her body while she's sleeping. The sheets are quite sheer i.e. you can see light through them but this makes them light and luxurious. They feel like a cross between silk and non-synthetic satin with a very fine sateen weave. The pockets on the fitted sheet are huge at 48cm so they easily fit deep mattresses. The elastic on the bottom sheet is excellent quality and the bottom sheet also has has a handy "Top or Bottom" and "Side" small, sewn-in tag for ease of orientation so the infernal process of trying to work out what goes where is permanently resolved. The pillow cases easily fit a large pillow and the envelope is the deepest I've seen at about 20cm. Ecoy sheets were also listed in Google AI's overview of the best bamboo sheets available in Australia, which helped with my decision. A set of sheets with 2 pillow cases was $180.00 delivered and the service was fast and hassle free.

title: May as well set my old sheets on fire now.
body:
I am OBSESSED with these sheets! I've been a sweaty sleeper for many years - and I haven't even hit perimenopause yet. 
I get horrible sweat rashes and in summer I often develop heat-triggered migraines even in my sleep. 
I never realised sheets could make this much of a difference! 

I can never go back to non-bamboo sheets now. These are the best sheets I've ever had. I looooove the look and feel of them, and I'm genuinely unsure if I've woken up sweaty at all in the 2 weeks I've had them. 

I bought the lagoon and honeycomb coloured sets and they are so vibrant and happy-making! 
I also have 2 cats - one black and one white (so no fabric colour is safe in this house) but somehow there are barely any strands of cat hair left behind. And those jerks are on my bed CONSTANTLY. 

I do not have a lot of cash, and after I placed my order I did freak out that I'd just spent so much money on sheets - especially ones I'd never even tried - but I have zero regrets. 
I now realise that all of my old sheets - that I had thought to be perfectly acceptable until now - actually only belong in a dumpster fire. 
I don't even want to use them for guests. 
Too embarrassing now I know what's out there. 

Anyway, buy these! 

Hey Ecoy, can you please restock jacaranda in queen size? I NEED THEM. 
And may I suggest introducing some colours like a coral pink and a fuschia pink? 10000000% would buy. 
Would probably also settle for a basic light pink too. 
Thank you 🙏🙏🙏

title: Do not buy - Major quality issues
body:
I was really optimistic about the product's marketing claims, and, broadly speaking, they hold up. These are very comfortable and very breathable sheets. Problems arise quite quickly, though. 

I correctly followed the washing instructions, and the sheets immediately and considerably shrunk, both in part due to the material and the amount of creases after washing. 

The fitted sheet corners are already beginning to fray and pull apart. My bed isn't particularly thick, which suggests this problem would be even worse on a thicker one. 

I've been using the sheets for about a month and am already planning to replace them, as I can assure you they will fall apart within 6 months. 

This is a known issue with Bamboo sheets, but I thought, given the price and reputation of Ecoy, that it would last longer, which was misguided and untrue. 

I would only recommend these sheets if you can afford to replace them completely fairly regularly, and even then, you'd be better off just getting silk. 

As such, do not get sucked into the marketing like I did, and buy sheets from a more reputable brand.

Full disclosure: I already had a pillow that I really love, and I almost didn't try out this one because of it. I'm glad I gave it a go because being able to swap between the warm and cool sides has been awesome.

title: Buyer beware-if I could give 0/5 stars I would
body: I was extremely excited to purchase some brand new bedding as I love vibrant colours and Ecoy has the best colours around. I live in Christchurch New Zealand and naively thought shipping would be a breeze in this 24/7 world we live in. I spent NZD$500 and waited the 6-10 days as advised on their website at the purchase stage, and my delivery never arrived. The person who responded to my anxious email simply said, more than once, that it "is not our fault. We have fulfilled our obligations." 4 emails later I discovered that Ecoy had just used normal postage for my order and actually didn't know where it was either? She advised I should wait another 2 weeks and if it doesn't turn up then - I had to chase up my order!!!  Myself!!! So if you are happy with a company that takes your hard earned dollars and can't pay a few dollars themselves to ship your goods to you, then Ecoy is the store for you. I am deeply disappointed by the lack of empathy and respect shown by Ecoy. But I am more disappointed I didn't get my lovely new Eggplant bedding I was so excited to receive.

title: Review of god's gift
body:
I bought these Ecoy bamboo sheets because I saw someone online raving about them and thought, "How good can sheets really be?"
Turns out… stupidly good. Like, life-upgrade good.
They're soft in that silky, "I should probably stop touching the bed and get back to work" kind of way. Cool enough that I don't wake up sweating through the night like a rotisserie chicken. And they actually stay on the mattress, which if you've ever fought with a fitted sheet at 10 pm, you know is a small miracle.
After washing, they came out just as soft and didn't shrink or go weird (looking at you, every cheap set I've ever owned). 
Honestly, if I ever go missing, check my bed first. I'll be there, wrapped up in my sheets, living my best horizontal life. Also how good is the Yellow, bright, happy and just makes me want to move to my bed full time.

Imagine the sweetness of honey, the silk of melted chocolate, the coolness of fresh fruit — all blended into fabric you can wrap yourself in. That's what these sheets deliver.

title: fragile fabric and not worth premium price.
body:
I did a lot of research to find a spare quilt cover set and fitted sheet that would last me at least 3 years and spend $260 in the hopes it would be money wisely spent.

 I have felt and seen bamboo sheets at a friends house, so decided the material would be a good choice as it seemed durable and soft. The ecoy fabric does feel very soft, smooth, cool and slippery. Unfortunately the fitted sheet that I received had a small tuft of raised fabric. I figured I would maybe get this replaced, but then when I washed the quilt cover set I realized there was a pull in that too and knew something had to be wrong with this fabric. I then tested another area pinching a bit between my nail as I had at my friend's house, and it could pull VERY easily. I tested on my linen sheets and cotton, and neither are as delicate as the ecoy fabric and this shouldn't happen. I could not feel comfortable sleeping on something like this, mayyyyybe the fitted sheet where it's covered most of the time, its far too delicate for bedding  Its the kind of fabric that might be appropriate for a scarf or a fancy formal blouse or something.

The customer service was prompt when I asked to speak to a human, and they promptly offered me a refund. At least there's that.

title: Smooth, silky and warm quilt
body:
I already bought a set of ecoy bamboo sheets, in Ocean Blue which I adore, they're so soft and silky , but breathable. So when it was time to upgrade my quilt, I came to see if there was something that would match. I ended up going with Grey Gum, as I love the bright sheets and grey would go with anything, and a Cloud quilt, because it was made of recycled materials and that seemed like a good thing to support in this day and age. Plus an extra set of Reef Teal sheets because the colour is devine!
I've been delighted by both. The grey is this beautiful, soft, dove grey that looks elegant even (perhaps especially?) when rumpled. I'm using it with my flannelette sheets at the moment because it's winter and it's very cold here in Canberra. I honestly didn't know what to expect from a quilt made from recycled bottles but you'd never know - it's fluffy, warm and nicely weighted for winter (king sized for queen bed). The material is soft and silky, like the sheets, and it slides easily over the bed when you roll over, even though it's a fairly hefty quilt. I also love that it ties into the quilt cover so you don't lose it in the night - this is a nice feature but also an essential one when you've got silky material or it'd slide down inside the cover at night. All in all, it's beautiful. I'll never go back to cotton sheets again - flannies for winter and bamboo for the rest of the year for me!

The fit is perfect, with deep pockets that hug the mattress snugly and don't shift around. I also love that Ecoy is committed to sustainability, which makes supporting them feel even better.

title: Absolutely obsessed – Ecoy does it again!
body:
I just received the new flippable bamboo linen quilt cover from Ecoy and WOW — it's everything I didn't know I needed. The quality is absolutely amazing, and the design is both adaptable and beautiful. One side has that soft, breathable bamboo feel, and the other gives you that airy soft linen vibe — perfect for changing seasons or just switching things up!

I've already got around 8 sets of Ecoy sheets/quilts, and honestly, it's been one of the best decisions of my life. My sleep quality has gone through the roof. Living in Northern Queensland, finding breathable, cooling bedding is a must — and Ecoy has nailed it. These are total game changers for hot and humid nights.

Bonus points for pet owners: I have two Ragdoll cats, and their fur doesn't cling like it does on other cheaper bedding. A quick vacuum or brush and it's good as new.

Can't recommend this enough — it's comfort, style, and practicality all in one.

title: Best sheets on the market
body:
I absolutely love my Ecoy sheets! I purchased them in the orange and navy blue colours, and not only do they look stunning, but they feel amazing too. The fabric is incredibly soft, cool, and comfortable — perfect for a restful night's sleep.

They're breathable and lightweight, which keeps me cool throughout the night, and the softness is unlike anything I've experienced before. The quality is evident, and they've held up beautifully after several washes with no signs of wear or pilling.

I should have made it clear in my first review that it's mainly my husband who has problems with these sheets. Because of the slippery mess and his reduced mobility he tends to end up with the top sheet under him or all of the sheet over his side of the bed. I, however, find the sheets very comfortable. title: These sheets are the best, Chuck out the rest
body:
If you're reading this congratulations! You have found the sheets you've been looking for! 

I know, it's pricey. Which is why I researched all the companies selling bamboo sheets and read the reviews. I found Ecoy to have the highest rated reviews. 

Also Ecoy has everything I was looking for: 
- good quality sheets that's soft (but not too silky that I'm going to slip off) 
- keep me warm but not hot (I have issues with overheating and sleep)
- wide range of bold 60s-70s colours to go with my vintage furniture (everyone else sells either mute, pastel or conservative colours) 

Took a punt and bought my first set - burnt orange. The sheets are everything all the reviews said and can confirm they met all my needs. I loved the sheets so much and immediately bought the teal second set when it came out. 

I thought the care guide for these sheets was going to be a downside (you have to wash these sheets on a gentle cycle (low spin) in cold water but it's fine, I throw them on the clothing line outside and hasn't increased my laundry time. 

I've been looking for years, relieved I finally found good quality sheets and can stop looking. They keep me cool which improved my sleep. 10/10 will buy these sheets again.

title: Did not live up to expectations
body:
I waited months, if not years to buy this set. I kept seeing it online with brilliant reviews and was waiting until I was certain I wanted to commit to the purchase, so it saddens me to now leave a 3 star review.
Pros: 
- The set looks just as good, if not even better than pictured. The colour is beautifully vibrant, and remains so after washing.
- The feel of these sheets is pure luxury. They are silky buttery smooth and an absolute treat.
- The sheets fit my king mattress with plenty of material to spare, whilst simultaneously not bunching up. This makes for a really easy bed-making experience, especially with the additional labels. Clearly the design has been well thought out.
Con:
The entire purpose for me researching and buying these sheets is for a cooler sleeping experience. My partner runs hot, whereas I run cold. It is a struggle in Australian summer to find sheets that one can comfortably sleep in during those peak hot nights. I now know, that these sheets are definitely not those. These sheets are actually warmer than the non-bamboo sheets I was looking to replace. Considering I'm not a hot sleeper, it was an unwelcome surprise to find these sheets making me sweat. Considering this is the entire reason I purchased these sheets, I am very disappointed with this outcome. I feel like no other reviews are saying this though so I guess make your own judgement if the pros outweigh the con for you? In the meantime we now have these beautiful autumn/winter sheets that we will enjoy

I was having the most horrible hot flushes and the hot and humid nights weren't helping.  Figured that someone must have thought of cool sheets and desperately Googled "cool sheets" one morning on the train.  Came across these, thought "yeah right, they can't be that good".  But was so desperate that I ordered them anyway.

Got them.  Washed them.  Slept in them.  Ordered another set the next morning - just in case, I don't know - my dryer broke or something and I had to sleep a night without them.

They drape over you.  They are so soft that it seems impossible.  My best friend has heard just "how good my sheets are" more times than he can count.  I no longer dread going to bed - I look forward to it.  I wonder, is this what really rich people feel like when they go to sleep?  Or someone up in Heaven?

And you know what?  That thought that I had after that Google search of - yeah right, they can't be that good?  They're not - they're better.

Get some!  Get 2 - just in case, I don't know - your dryer breaks and you have to sleep without them.

title: Luxurious Comfort and Style: Oatmeal Bamboo Bedding & Burnt Orange Quilt Cover
body:
I recently purchased oatmeal bamboo bedding along with a burnt orange quilt cover and pillowcases, and I'm absolutely in love with them! The bamboo sheets are incredibly soft and breathable, providing a perfect balance of warmth and coolness. They're gentle on my skin, hypoallergenic, and offer a noticeable improvement in my sleep quality.

The burnt orange quilt cover is a stunning addition to my bedroom. It adds a rich, earthy pop of color that's vibrant but still calming. The quilt is lightweight yet cozy, and the color hasn't faded after washing. It pairs perfectly with the oatmeal bamboo sheets for a warm, inviting look.

The pillowcases are just as luxurious, offering the same silky-soft feel as the sheets. They match the quilt cover perfectly and complete the elegant look of the bed.

What's even better is that this bedding is easy to care for and incredibly durable. The bamboo fabric stays soft and strong after several washes, and I love knowing that it's made from an eco-friendly material.

Overall, this bedding set has transformed my sleep experience. It's cozy, stylish, and sustainable – I couldn't be happier with my purchase!

Back in December my partner and I decided to try the Cooling Sheets, and they've been a game-changer for our sleep-especially in the Australian heat! My partner struggles with hot nights, but these sheets have genuinely improved our comfort. And honestly the dogs love it too!!

title: Superb bedding
body:
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
I recently purchased the Sateen Bamboo Sheet Set from EcoY, and I cannot express how thrilled I am with my decision! From the moment I unboxed these sheets, I was impressed by their sheer elegance and quality.

First and foremost, the softness of the bamboo fabric is unparalleled. It feels incredibly luxurious against the skin, making every night's sleep feel like a five-star hotel experience. The sateen finish adds a subtle sheen that not only looks beautiful but also enhances the overall comfort. I've never looked forward to bedtime quite like this before!

Another standout feature is the breathability of the bamboo material. Living in a warmer climate, I often struggle with overheating at night, but these sheets have been a game changer. They regulate temperature beautifully, keeping me cool during the night while still providing just the right amount of warmth during cooler evenings.

The EcoY Sateen Bamboo Sheet Set also boasts impressive durability. After several washes, I noticed that they maintained their shape and softness remarkably well, without any signs of pilling or fading. It's clear that these sheets are made to last, which is a huge plus for anyone looking to invest in quality bedding.

Moreover, I appreciate EcoY's commitment to sustainability. Knowing that these sheets are made from eco-friendly bamboo gives me peace of mind, knowing that I'm making a responsible choice for the environment without sacrificing comfort or style.

Lastly, the range of colors available is fantastic, allowing for easy coordination with any bedroom decor. I chose the classic white, and it adds a fresh, clean look to my space.

In conclusion, if you're in search of a luxurious, comfortable, and sustainable bedding solution, look no further than the Sateen Bamboo Sheet Set from EcoY. They have truly transformed my sleep experience, and I highly recommend them to anyone looking to elevate their bedding game.

This sleep mask is the perfect alternative to the traditional elasticated design. It is way more comfortable and can be adjusted to the perfect size using the silent soft Velcro (which is also satisfying to use on a sensory level!). Curious, I delved into researching such an item and found "ecoy" mentioned several times. And being a notoriously hot sleeper - nude and no top sheet in Queensland's steamy summer - I had to give the Cooling Bamboo Sheet Set a try.  The result? title: excellent and warm
body:
i initially purchased these because my old quilts kept slipping around the inside of my bamboo quilt covers and it was driving me nuts. i wanted ones that could be tied into place. 

i am sleeping sooooo well. the quilts are deliciously warm and heavy and i love that you can clip them together (and to the inside of the quilt cover). i haven't run into any overheating issues either.

i have only run into two minor issues so far:
- they are truly extremely fluffy and huge. i bought the queen sized set and had to wash them separately, and the 'mid season' quilt almost didn't fit into my front loader. so if you get that size or bigger, you may have difficulties washing them.
- sometimes when i tug the quilt (i sleep with the blankets smooshed up and around my head) the blankets unsnap in a couple of places. it's not a big problem since there are so many snaps around each edge but if you're particular about that kind of thing, you'll find it annoying.

overall, very happy with them!

I initially bought one sheet and duvet cover set just to try them out as I was on the market for hypoallergenic bedding. After falling completely in love with how they feel on my skin (& allergies), I have now donated all my other sheets/covers and invested in some additional Ecoy sets. 
Definitely worth noting that I don't run hot when i sleep, but my boyfriend does, and somehow, we are both the right temperature in our Ecoy sheets. 
The complimentary linen spray was a nice touch! Thanks Ecoy. I am officially a loyal customer.

title: Unmatched Comfort and Eco-Friendliness - A Must-Have!
body:
I recently invested in a set of bamboo sheets and I must say, they have completely transformed my sleeping experience! The first thing I noticed was the incredibly soft texture, which feels luxurious against the skin. These sheets are not just soft; they're also very breathable, which has been a game changer for my sleep quality, especially during the warmer nights.

One of the standout features of these bamboo sheets is their thermoregulating properties. They keep me cool when it's hot and warm when it's cold, ensuring comfort throughout the night. I'm also very pleased with how well they wash. After several washes, they've retained their softness and color without any pilling or shrinkage.

Another significant benefit is the sustainability aspect. Knowing that these sheets are eco-friendly and made from a renewable resource gives me great peace of mind.

In conclusion, if you're on the fence about whether to try bamboo sheets, I highly recommend you go for it. They are definitely worth the investment for anyone looking to upgrade their bedding with something soft, durable, and environmentally friendly. Absolutely delighted with my purchase!

The customer service of Ecoy is outstanding and I can only highly recommend it!

title: Great sheets
body:
Stop the press! These sheets are the real deal!

So, picture this: I'm lounging in bed like a panda in a bamboo forest, except instead of munching on leaves, I'm snoozing on the comfiest, coziest sheets I've ever experienced. And where do these magical sheets come from, you ask? Ecoy, my friends. Ecoy.

First off, let's talk color. Forest green? More like "make-everyone-else-green-with-envy" green! It's like sleeping in a lush, tranquil oasis every night. My bedroom went from blah to spa-like sanctuary in seconds flat.

But wait, there's more! These sheets are softer than a cloud made of kitten fur. Seriously, I've never felt anything so luxurious against my skin. It's like being cradled by a million tiny, eco-friendly angels.

And the best part? They're bamboo! Not only am I sleeping like royalty, but I'm also doing my part for Mother Earth. It's a win-win situation, folks.

So, if you're tired of subpar sheets cramping your style, do yourself a favor and invest in some Ecoy bamboo sheets. Your bed will thank you, your skin will thank you, and heck, even your dreams will thank you. Trust me, you won't regret it!

P.S. If you catch me snoozing in the middle of the day, blame it on these sheets. They're just too darn comfy to leave!

The sheets arrived quickly, the customer service team are amazing and the fabric is deliciously soft and silky!  I love the colour and not overheating at night! The deep fitted sheet and wide elastic makes making the bed a breeze especially if you have a thick mattress or one of the mattress toppers for added squishyness. The pillow cases are a great size if you have big fluffy pillows like I do, but smaller flatter ones have a bit of room, also the fabric is prone to wrinkles but it doesnt affect the making of the bed (idk why yall are upset about wrinkles… theyre sheets not clothes) 
I also have sensory issues and these sheets feel so so nice and smooth, theyre very comfy but folding them for storage is an adventure as they are quite slippery 

11/10 will be replacing all of my cotton sheets with these!

title: Silky & Smooth
body:
Kraft would have you believe it makes silky smooth peanut butter, and while it does, I guarantee you haven't truly experienced silky or smooth till you've stripped down, slipped into your bed and felt the cool embrace of Ecoy's manchester delights.

I've always been a simple cotton bloke. I didn't know any better. A few months ago the algorithms introduced me to bamboo products and visually, Ecoy's forest green quilt cover stole my whole heart. I then began to research. Ecoy's range were competitively priced, with a homely colour palette and some top notch, responsive customer service. It was a no-brainer. 

I purchased the Queen Sage Cooling Bamboo Sheet Set and King Forest Green Quilt Cover.

There were no shipping issues and they were packaged with care.  

As I jumped into bed that first night, I just smiled like an idiot. It was overwhelming how comfortable, luxurious and cool the sheets were and I couldn't believe I'd denied myself this pleasure for so long.

I love the little features of the extra length for tucking, the top and bottom markers on the sheets and the sturdy zip on the quilt cover. The ties on the inside of the quilt cover keep it in place so no mucking around.

It's been about two months now and no issues. They're just as comfortable when I first purchased them. I sleep hot and they are super cool so we're a match made in heaven. I tell anyone who will listen to get on the bamboo bandwagon and to reach out to the legends at Ecoy. They obviously care about a good night sleep and given you spend a 1/3 of your life doing just that- the math says that they care about you!

Thanks Ecoy for creating such beautiful products. I'll be back for more cool silky smooth goodies this year.

title: Very Silky and Soft
body:
These sheets are the silkiest softest sheets I've ever had and feel beautiful. However I'm not sure as yet whether this is a good thing or not as they feel rather thin and crease easily. I have only used them for a week on my new mattress which has a pure cotton under blanket on it. I'm finding that the fitted sheet slides up and becomes untucked at the sides. I feel that the sheet isn't deep enough to allow enough tuck in and the elastic is not strong enough. I'm also finding that my bedding is sliding around and ends up to one side. Apart from that I must say that the sheets do feel lovely to sleep on but they make it harder to make the bed as I practically have to remake again in the morning.
I have some Bamboo sheets that I purchased from a bedding shop and I love them. They are rather thick but yet have a lovely feel soft feel to them and wash up beautifully and show very little signs of wear even though they are a couple of years old.  It is for this reason that I ordered my new Bamboo sheets thinking that they would be much the same but I was surprised when I received them of how different they feel.
